note: Tracked shortfalls the actor placement checks (tools/chim/actor_census_check.py, tools/actor_spec_check.py) accept: area/kind -> missing count, its register entry and why. A gap that closes lowers its number here in the same commit; anything else short of the original stops the build. set_aside: the places a build with the expansions selected sets aside on purpose, by the group the stages record them under; tools/actor_spec_check.py leaves an expansion's references there out of both sides and lists each place with this register entry (a base game reference there still counts as missing).

interior/CREA.why: the three placed rats of Drarayne Thelas' house and storage (Balmora town stage rooms)

interior/LEVC.why: Addamasartus (1) and Tharys Ancestral Tomb (3): the intro scene stage converts them with the older room path

interior/NPC_.why: one NPC of Vivec, Telvanni Mage and one of Vivec, The Lizard's Head, skipped by the room converter

exterior_like.why: an interior that behaves like an exterior (Mournhold's districts): the room batch stage leaves it out until the Mournhold exterior work (room-batches.json exterior_like)

refused.why: an expansion room the room batch stage refused, with its error (room-batches.json refused)

empty.why: an interior cell the game data leaves empty (no scenery the room converter keeps, at most an actor; no door leads into it): the room batch stage lists it with what it holds and the doors into it, and makes no room of it (room-batches.json empty)

unplanned_exterior.why: an exterior cell only an expansion adds (Solstheim): the exterior plan does not plan it, so no map of the build holds it
